concepts.canonical_he: כלי וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד
concepts.gloss_en: A vessel and channel through which to receive the divine chesed (gradually)

members.form: כלי וצנור לקבל על ידו החסד
כלי וצנור לקבל על ידו השׁפעת החסד

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the same descriptive phrase from LM II:4 (relation=eitza, partner=יראה): making a vessel/channel to receive the chesed. The only difference is one inserts השפעת ('influx of') before החסד — a trivial expansion of the same idea, not a different concept. Same teaching, same meaning; merge stands.
